spec.model_name: 9 API models (claude-opus-4, gpt-5.5, gemini-2.5-pro, gpt-4.1, claude-sonnet-4, gpt-4o, gemini-2.5-flash, gpt-4o-mini, claude-3-haiku)
spec.eval_data: mmlu + arc_challenge, 300 pairs each, 6 attacks + clean

experiment_data.hypothesis: Expanding from 6 to 15 models (9 API + 6 local) across 6 families and 3 capability tiers breaks the structural K_eff-η_max collinearity (r=-0.8 with 6 models). With 15 models, panels can have high K_eff (cross-family diversity) without necessarily including weak judges, enabling clean separation of diversity vs robustness effects.
